references.text: Jeremiah speaks of persecution and suffering resulting from faithfulness to God, which reflects Jesus' warnings in Matthew.
Jesus warns the disciples about the persecution and opposition they will face, which aligns with the message in Matthew 24:9.
Luke gives a parallel description of the persecution of Jesus' disciples, which corresponds with the predictions in Matthew 24:9.
The Acts of the Apostles describes early Christian persecution, reflecting Jesus' warnings about persecution.
Paul reminds Timothy that all who want to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted, echoing Jesus' words in Matthew 24:9.
